name: minimax-vscode
description: Language model provider for GitHub Copilot in VS Code: use MiniMax M2/M2.5/M2.7/M3 models for programming with a Token Plan API key over the Anthropic-compatible API. Does not add speech, video, or image generation APIs.

minimax.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: MiniMax Anthropic-compatible API base URL. Use `https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic` for users in China, or `https://api.minimax.io/anthropic` for international users. The Anthropic SDK appends `/v1/messages` automatically.

minimax.apiKey.markdownDescription: Fallback MiniMax API key when SecretStorage is unavailable (e.g. CI/automation). Prefer the in-product API key navigation action, which stores the key in SecretStorage.

minimax.visibleModels.markdownDescription: Programming text models (M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed / M3) for Token Plan. M3 is the latest native-multimodal frontier coding model (officially 1M context; effective 512K until the >512K tier is fully rolled out). MiniMax no longer recommends M2.5 and earlier.

minimax.commitModel.markdownDescription: Model used by **MiniMax: Generate Commit Message**. Defaults to `MiniMax-M2.7` for a fast, deterministic draft. Switch to `MiniMax-M3` when you need deeper reasoning on a complex refactor or migration.

minimax.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum number of output tokens. `0` (default) lets the model decide. Hard cap: 524288 for M2.x, 512000 for M3.

minimax.debugMode.markdownDescription: Diagnostic verbosity. `verbose` writes full request payloads to `<globalStorage>/request-dumps/<segmentId>/` for debugging.

minimax.modelIdOverrides.markdownDescription: Override the API model ID for each picker model ID. Useful when routing through a third-party proxy that uses different model names.

minimax.visionModel.markdownDescription: Language model chat ID used to describe image attachments for non-multimodal MiniMax models. Leave empty to auto-detect. Has no effect on `MiniMax-M3` which receives images directly.

minimax.visionPrompt.default:
Describe all image attachments in this message.

If there is one image, describe it directly.
If there are multiple images:
1. Describe each image separately, preserving their order.
2. Then provide a combined description explaining the overall context and relationships across the images.

Return one concise factual description suitable for inserting into a text-only chat prompt. Include visible text, objects, UI elements, people, and relevant context. Do not invent details.
minimax.visionPrompt.markdownDescription: Prompt sent to the vision proxy when describing image attachments for non-multimodal MiniMax models.

minimax.experimental.stabilizeToolList.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** When the Copilot host presents placeholder `activate_*` tools, synthesise preflight tool calls so the tool list stays stable across turns. Improves cache hit rate but adds extra round-trips. Restart the chat session after changing.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with MiniMax
walkthroughs.description: Configure the MiniMax Token Plan API key, pick a model, and tune advanced settings.

steps.title: Set your API key
steps.description: Use the **MiniMax: Set API Key** command to store your Token Plan API key in VS Code SecretStorage.

steps.title: Pick your API endpoint
steps.description: International users can use **MiniMax: Switch to Global API**; users in China can use **MiniMax: Switch to Chinese API**. Both use the Anthropic-compatible protocol.

steps.title: Choose a model
steps.description: Open the Copilot Chat model picker and select any **MiniMax** model. Run **MiniMax: Show Pricing** to compare cost.

steps.title: Tune advanced settings
steps.description: Adjust `minimax.visibleModels`, `minimax.maxTokens`, `minimax.debugMode`, and `minimax.experimental.stabilizeToolList` from the Settings UI.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: MiniMax Token Plan API key from platform.minimax.io (Account / Token Plan).
